Overland 1.0.9

Incorporates key upstream GlobalProtect-openconnect fixes for macOS DNS & split-tunnel handling, log redaction, URL/port parsing, client certificate validation, and native macOS HIP host info.

Highlights

  • Ephemeral macOS DNS & Split-Tunnel Support: Adopted upstream's scutil-only macOS DNS resolver configuration (OverridePrimary + SearchOrder + split-tunnel source tracking) and removed persistent networksetup -setdnsservers writes so physical Wi-Fi/Ethernet DNS settings are never left modified across crashes or reboots.
  • Faster Disconnect on Unresponsive Gateways: Reduced the disconnect grace timeout before escalating to forced teardown when a gateway stops responding to logout.
  • Security & Log Hygiene: Redacted sensitive cookies, passwords, SAML payloads, and globalprotectcallback: tokens from Activity Logs, and enforced server certificate pins in OpenConnect's peer validation callback.
  • Custom Port & URL Normalization: Pasting full portal or gateway URLs (including explicit :port and IPv6 [host]:port) now strips schemes/paths while preserving custom ports.
  • Client Certificate Validation & macOS HIP Info: Added pre-connect checks for missing or unreadable client certificate/key files, and updated HIP posture reporting to detect real macOS version (sw_vers) and built-in Wi-Fi MAC (networksetup) as the host ID.

Requirements

macOS 14 or later. Run Overland from /Applications or ~/Applications for seamless privileged helper registration.

Overland 1.0.8

Fixes repeated administrator password prompts by preserving SMAppService helper approval across Sparkle updates.

Highlights

  • Seamless Helper Reload on Update: OverlandHelper now detects when its binary on disk has been replaced by an in-place Sparkle update and exits cleanly while idle so launchd spawns the updated helper automatically—without ever calling SMAppService.unregister() or revoking Login Items approval.
  • No More Unexpected Password Prompts: Removed automatic helper unregistration on launch/connect so existing System Settings approvals stay intact across updates.
  • Helper Approval Banner: Added a clear banner on the main Connection view with one-click Open System Settings… and Re-check buttons whenever Login Items approval is needed.

Requirements

macOS 14 or later. Run Overland from /Applications or ~/Applications for seamless privileged helper registration.

Overland 1.0.7

Automatic privileged helper updates after Sparkle installs, reconnect/disconnect route & DNS preservation fixes, and main window navigation improvements.

Highlights

  • Automatic Privileged Helper Updates: Overland now detects stale privileged helper versions or XPC protocol mismatches on launch and during connect (such as after an in-place Sparkle update) and automatically re-registers the updated helper daemon without requiring manual uninstall/reinstall.
  • Reconnect / Disconnect Network Fix: Fixed vpnc-script bugs where reconnecting overwrote the original default route and DNS backups with VPN addresses, and where missing resolv.conf backups skipped macOS scutil/networksetup teardown. Disconnect now preserves original backups, always cleans up macOS DNS/resolver state, and automatically triggers DHCP recovery if the default route is missing.
  • Main Window Navigation Fix: Fixed NavigationSplitView sidebar selection so switching to Activity Logs (or Gateways) reliably switches back to the current Connection view, added a Connection back button in the toolbar when away from the Connection tab, and opened Activity Logs from failure cards in the dedicated Logs window.

Requirements

macOS 14 or later. Run Overland from /Applications or ~/Applications for seamless privileged helper registration.
